items.sentence: Objective description tries to describe things as they are, without interference from the writer's personal perceptions or feelings. Impressionistic description, on the contrary, emphasizes the writer's perceptions and feelings.
items.prompt: on the contrary가 나타내는 관계를 고르세요.
items.explanation: 객관적 묘사와 인상주의적 묘사의 성격을 반대로 대비합니다.

items.sentence: The probability that you select a red ball from an opaque box is not affected by how many times a black ball has previously been selected. Similarly, the probability of having a baby of a certain gender has nothing to do with earlier births.
items.explanation: 독립 사건이라는 공통 원리를 두 사례에 적용하므로 Similarly가 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: If production workers find out that a device assembled two weeks ago has a problem with it, they almost certainly won't recall the circumstances surrounding the operation at that time. On the other hand, if the feedback is received the next day or, better yet, the same day, immediate corrective action can be taken.
items.prompt: On the other hand가 연결하는 관계를 고르세요.
items.explanation: 늦은 피드백과 빠른 피드백의 결과를 서로 대비합니다.

items.sentence: If production workers find out that a device assembled two weeks ago has a problem with it, they almost certainly won't recall the circumstances surrounding the operation at that time.
items.prompt: find out 뒤 that절의 본동사를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: that절의 주어는 a device이고 assembled two weeks ago는 수식어구이므로 본동사는 has입니다.
